acceptance.artifact: workstreams/po03/capsule/ implementation plus tests including a fresh-clone resolution test
acceptance.assertion: A capsule is expressed as a set of (path, blob SHA, commit SHA) triples resolvable read-only from git alone; resolving a capsule from a fresh clone with no working tree yields byte-identical content; and a legitimate change to a pinned source produces a new capsule version with explicit lineage to its predecessor instead of mutating the frozen one.
acceptance.falsified_if: a capsule can be resolved to different bytes at two times, or a source change can occur without issuing a new capsule version

hypothesis: Pinning a source capsule by git commit SHA rather than by the hash of a mutable working-tree path makes post-dispatch drift impossible by construction rather than merely detectable.
